name: 覚えた語と復習する語の結果
prompt: Redesign this Japanese learning-results panel as a single 390×260 image. The native Japanese preview is authoritative for exact layout, copy, type scale and state. The attached user image is palette guidance only; do not copy its geometry. Keep the page background pure white (#FFFFFF). Change every pale mint/green tinted metric pill to pure white with a thin neutral gray outline (#E5E7EB); keep the same pill shapes, order, sizes, positions, labels and spacing. Do not use any tinted fills, green-tinted pills, lavender, mint, blue, cyan, yellow, gradients, color washes or shadows. Preserve near-black text. Keep the existing bottom primary action as a flat solid forest green matching the native button (#047857), with white text; no gradient or shadow. Preserve exact Japanese text and punctuation: 今回学んだことば; 4語; 75%; 覚えた：3; 復習する語：1; もう一度復習する. Keep the same horizontal/centered alignment, text sizes, corner radii and 390×260 crop. Do not add icons, cards, artwork, decorations or copy. No English text.
reviewNotes: White metric pills remove tint; solid green CTA and lighter neutral outlines need one focused correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
